text: The tool kit is strapped underneath the pillion seat. The first part of the kit is: Allen key 8 mm, Allen key 6 mm, Allen key 5 mm, Allen key 4 mm, C-spanner, double end spanner 10 x 13 and extension tube, one of each. The rest of the kit is: fuse puller (1), ring spanner 24 x 14 combination (1), double end spanner 12 x 16 (2) and front spindle adapter (1).
